text:
Type: tall glass-door bookcase
Use: displaying and storing books, collections and glassware; living room, home office, dining room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: laminated board in a beige finish, two framed glass doors, adjustable shelves, small knobs
Colors: light warm beige, clear glass
Shape: tall narrow upright case with two full-height glass doors split by a mid rail, many evenly spaced shelves, small knobs, plain plinth base, slim and tall, medium visual weight
Feel: calm, orderly, soft, neutral
Goes with: white or cream walls, light wood, warm neutral textiles; Scandinavian living rooms, studies and home libraries

product.name: BILLY
product.description: Glass doors keep your favourite items free from dust but still visible.
